stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “During PE class, students had to leave their shoes outside the gym.”?
options: The science teacher said this was a useful lesson.
The teacher gave him another sheet and said, "Slow hands can still learn."
The teacher said, "A museum does not begin with glass boxes.
Their teacher said the accident was not serious, but it was useful.
